biggest_catch: The 'up to $620' is a ceiling, not a flat bonus: the per-task dollar values are not published on the official page — each task's reward is assigned inside Digital Banking when you activate it — and 'Tasks and rewards are subject to change without notice.' You must also click Activate for each activity BEFORE doing it, or you earn nothing.
catches: Up to $620 is earned through the CashBack+ program in Digital Banking — you must log in and click Activate for each activity before completing it; unactivated activities earn $0.

Tasks include signing up for direct deposit, using your debit card, and choosing eStatements; complete each activated task within your New Member Period (account open date plus the following three full calendar months — 3 to 4 months total).
Per-task reward amounts are shown only in Digital Banking at activation; the official page does not publish each task's dollar value, and tasks/rewards are subject to change without notice.
Rewards are credited to a CashBack+ wallet within 35 days of meeting each requirement, then transferred as cash or redeemed for gift cards.
Open an Everyday, Premier, or High Yield Spending account beginning 2/20/25; offer does not apply to second/multiple spending accounts.
Not available to existing members; limited to one bonus per household; the spending account must remain open a minimum of three months; not valid with any other Stanford FCU promotional offer.
Stanford FCU membership eligibility is required.
Taxes on the bonus are the recipient's responsibility; bonuses are reported to tax agencies.

steps: Join Stanford Federal Credit Union (membership eligibility required) and open an Everyday, Premier, or High Yield Spending account.
Log in to Digital Banking and open CashBack+ (Prizeout).
Click Activate for each reward activity BEFORE completing it — signing up for direct deposit, using your debit card, and choosing eStatements (each task's reward value is shown at activation).
Complete each activated task within your New Member Period (your open date plus the following three full calendar months).
Your rewards appear in your CashBack+ wallet within 35 days of each completed task — transfer them to your account as cash or redeem for gift cards (up to $620 total).
timing: Each reward credited to the CashBack+ wallet within 35 days of meeting its requirements; transferable as cash or gift cards from there.
